answer_1.quote: We introduce DiffusionAttacker, which reformulates prompt rewriting as a conditional text generation task.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the generated jailbreak prompts from four perspectives: fluency (PPL), attack success rate (ASR), diversity (Self-BLEU), and the average time taken to generate a jailbreak prompt (Time).

answer_3.quote: To address its limitations, we leverage GPT-4o as a classifier to assess both the harmfulness of the output and its alignment with the harmful intent of the instruction.
